DitherRadarChart.axes: The axis labels, clockwise from 12 o'clock. Three or more read best.
DitherRadarChart.series: The series, drawn in order with later ones on top, each { label, values, color, fill }. Missing values count as 0. A transparent color takes the next colour of the series.
DitherRadarChart.max: The value at the outer ring. 0 picks it.
DitherRadarChart.rings: Grid rings, which also set the steps of the gradient fill.
DitherRadarChart.grid: polygon for straight edges or circle for round rings.
DitherRadarChart.size: The largest width and height. The chart shrinks to fit its container.
DitherRadarChart.unit: Written after every value in the readout.
DitherRadarChart.legend: Show the legend. Hover a key to spotlight a series, click to lock it.
DitherRadarChart.interactive: The axis readout and the legend spotlight.
DitherRadarChart.animated: The series grow out from the centre.
DitherRadarChart.matrix: The dither pattern of the gradient fills.
